fields.name: show_cursor_trail
fields.description: If true, will show a trail following cursor. Requested by joss

fields.name: active_time
fields.description: If this is a projectile then add -1 for active time

fields.name: update_targets_every_frame
fields.description: If active, then each model update it will re-evaluate the targets based on the current position. When off, it will do it once at the start and the targets won't change even if they move in / out of range.

fields.name: always_affect_self
fields.description: The launch unit will always be affected by the ability

fields.name: only_affect_target
fields.description: The ability will only affect the target unit and will not search near units

fields.name: min_range
fields.description: The (targetted) ability can't be used within this range

fields.name: targetting_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when targetting

fields.name: passive_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability has been ordered but not yet cast (like if unit has to move their to cast)

fields.name: active_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability is currently active (has been cast)

fields.name: activation_effect
fields.description: This is an optional one-shot vfx to display when cast to acknowledge order given

fields.name: miscast_chance
fields.description: The unary chance of a miscast occuring

fields.name: miscast_explosion
fields.description: The boom-boom when miscasting happens

fields.name: special_ability_display
fields.description: When wind_up_stance has an animation added, and windup_time is set to greater than zero, this references a table where you can override effects in the animations metadata.   The effect metadata needs to be set to be set to ability_weapon and ability_aura.

fields.name: voiceover_state
fields.description: the state for the voiceover that's played when this ability is activated (if any)

fields.name: additional_melee_cp
fields.description: Melee Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: additional_missile_cp
fields.description: Missile Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: parent_ability
fields.description: Hack for spell browser in warhammer because designers want to put in specialised versions of abilities for certain characters. An ability with a parent wont show in browser, instead only parent is shown.

fields.name: spawn_proxy_vfx
fields.description: Vfx to show over each proxy decal when targetting spawn spell

fields.name: miscast_global_bonus
fields.description: Setting this to false stops miscast chance modifiers from affecting the ability

fields.name: composite_scene_group_on_wind_up
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the ability starts winding up

fields.name: composite_scene_group_on_active
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the ability actives

fields.name: use_loop_stance
fields.description: Entities will play a loop locomotion stance

fields.name: spawn_is_transformation
fields.description: If spawning a unit will mean the owner unit will be replaced by the spawned one

fields.name: spawn_is_decoy
fields.description: If spawning a unit the new one will be understood as a decoy of the owner one, the UI will show data for the owning one

fields.name: current_mana_moves_to_reserve
fields.description: If true the current winds of magic mana gets moved to the reserve

fields.name: spawn_shares_health_and_fatigue
fields.description: If spawning a unit will mean the transformed unit health and fatigue will be shared with the owning unit

fields.name: affect_siege_equipment
fields.description: If true affects siege equipment entities

fields.name: shared_recharge_time
fields.description: If provided will set this cooldown timer to all abilities on same group that have the field set

fields.name: intensity_based_activation
fields.description: Activates automatically when intensity is above 0 and deactivates otherwise

fields.name: autoresolver_usage
fields.description: How the ability is used in autoresolver calculations

fields.name: autoresolver_targets
fields.description: Number of targets the ability will hit if it is an aoe ability

fields.name: display_stops_when_display_expires
fields.description: If the ability shoots bombardment/vortex it's display will stop when the assets naturally expire (please make sure the display triggered doesn't loop infinite)

fields.name: autoresolve_cp_multiplier
fields.description: Multiplier for the CP values

fields.name: can_be_copied_to_transformation_unit
fields.description: If this ability can be copied to the connected transformation Unit

fields.name: audio_switch_casting_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular casting

fields.name: audio_switch_ui_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular UI

fields.name: ai_usage_template_group
fields.description: If set, ability will trigger on any template.

fields.name: cant_move
fields.description: Makes the unit unable to be given movement or attack orders (entities can still shoot, use abilities or react to melee).

fields.name: freeze_fatigue
fields.description: Makes the unit fatigue state 0 (=fresh) for duration of phase

fields.name: fatigue_change_ratio
fields.description: This is a scalar that changes the unit's fatigue (PER SECOND) relative to the maximum. For example, -0.25 will reduce it by 25% and 0.1 will increase it by 10%

fields.name: ability_recharge_change
fields.description: if the unit has abilities, their recharge will be changed by that amount (negative will reduce the time, positive will increase the time)

fields.name: hp_change_frequency
fields.description: In seconds, how often hp (hit point) change should attempt to be applied

fields.name: damage_amount
fields.description: Per entity, per frequency, what the amount of damage to apply. Note amounts under 4 do not work well on small unit sizes.

fields.name: max_damaged_entities
fields.description: Per damage/heal frequency, how many entities can we affect (negative is no limit)

fields.name: resurrect
fields.description: If ticked, when healing excess hit points will resurrect dead soldiers

fields.name: mana_regen_mod
fields.description: How much we add to the current recharge for mana per second

fields.name: mana_max_depletion_mod
fields.description: How much we add to the current value for max mana depletion

fields.name: imbue_magical
fields.description: Does this phase imbue the target with magical attacks?

fields.name: imbue_ignition
fields.description: Does this phase imbue the target with flaming attacks?

fields.name: imbue_contact
fields.description: Does this phase imbue the target with a contact phase when attacking?

fields.name: phase_display
fields.description: Add groups of visual effects

fields.name: is_hidden_in_ui
fields.description: If true, will not show up in UI

fields.name: replenish_ammo
fields.description: How much ammunition we want to replenish when phase starts (can be negative if we want to spend), this value is in percentage of unit max ammo

fields.name: composite_scene_group
fields.description: Composite scene group we need to trigger when the phase starts

fields.name: freeze_recharge
fields.description: Abilities on the target do not recharge while this phase is active

fields.name: heal_amount
fields.description: When HP (hit points) are healed, how much total should be changed, spread amoungst the entities

fields.name: barrier_heal_amount
fields.description: Each hp_change_frequency ticks, the barrier will heal by this proportion of max_barrier_health

fields.name: execute_ratio
fields.description: At or below this ratio of health the ability will instantly kill its target

fields.name: attribute_type
fields.description: Positive means the affected will have the attribute, Negative means the affected will negate the attribute

localisedFields.name: alt_description
localisedFields.description: Opposite text, as sometimes this can read better in UI to avoid double negatives

row.text: The Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, leeching its spirit through tainted sorcery.
It’s raining death! A deadly rain of skulls comes down with bone-shattering force, sending lethal splinters flying in all directions.
The sky opens and a bolt of burning, pure Chaos black lightning hurtles towards the foe.
Tendrils of solidified darkness writhe outwards, draining the lifeforce from foes and renewing the caster’s own vigour.
Harnessing the sickly power of Shyish, the Wizard weakens the foe's will to survive the battle.
As the caster utters a forbidden name, their enemies are wracked with waves of agony.
This ice-cold breath delivers freezing death, slowing down those who are fortunate to survive the exposure.
This ice-cold breath delivers freezing death, slowing down those who are fortunate to survive the exposure.
Possession of this orb enables the user to inexorably drag the foe into a turbulent vortex of pain and death.
Sotek's crawling, swarming allies surround the bearer, affording them further might and protection in the struggle to come.
A scorching ray of light blasts forth from the sky, putting the foe to flight or screaming, burning death - preferably the latter!
More than just a pile of rubble, these rocks also split armour apart, negating its protective capability.
The surprising ability to hold back death despite some seriously heavy opposition…
This ancient golden screen - as old as the fabled golden city of the Lizardmen - confers missile resistance to both the bearer and their allies.
The presence of the hated Lustrian Blot Toad sends the merciless Ripperdactyls into a barely-controlled frenzy of extreme violence!
Steam must be let off from time to time, which leads to screaming, scalding death for any foe too close to the Emperor's Wrath during battle.
Now you see them, now you don’t… and now you’re seeing double.
Like their huge, earth-boring equivalents, Warp-Grinders can turn solid rock into dust on a smaller scale, halting enemies’ movements by pulverising the ground beneath them.
The Siren’s voice is a fearsome weapon – should its sound reach an enemy’s ears, their lifeblood begins to violently rebel through every pore.
Warp-energy channelled directly into the ground causes the earth to tremble at a frequency that causes brains to rattle within skulls and bones to splinter!
The Phoenix's spiralling dive whips the Winds of Magic into a swirling vortex of magical flame.
This is a hidden ability that enables some flashy persistent banner VFX to indicate that a unit explodes
A bestial roar causes both spirit and strength to weaken.
Some Dragons’ noxious fumes alone have long-lasting effects on their target's coordination – if survived in the first place.
Throwing bits of yourself at the enemy is either a sign of great determination... or singular stupidity.
Despite being an adolescent in Dragon terms, Gordinar’s breath blazes with the intense power of the sun itself.
The Wizard draws wholesome energies from the soil, imbuing companions with the natural resilience of the earth.
This spell temporarily transforms allies' mortal flesh into unbreakable rock, increasing tenfold their resistance to attack.
By speaking Druthandor's name the Wizard is able to heal allies' injuries much faster than by natural means.
The mutated, stitched nightmare roars in pain as a surge of specially concocted Growth Juice courses through its foul body.
A Bladesinger’s dance may start as a mesmerising, graceful pirouette, but always ends as a violent maelstrom of slicing, gashing slaughter!
Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.
The caster calls down a mighty ball of lightning and hurls it - should the foe be struck they will surely be shattered!
All Lizardmen are roused at the wailing cry of the Troglodon, its eerie call stirring their savagery.
When a bomb is smashed, a dark smoke curls out, concealing those who wish to hide and choking everyone else.
Unimpeded by armour and flesh, a Terrorgheist’s horrible shriek travels through its victims, splintering bones and souls, and erasing all memory of courage.
Crude though it may be, swiftly swooping in low to pepper the foe with rocks remains a most effective tactic.
Just give the order and the Hydra's heads will spew forth their fiery breath, each competing for the brightest flame.
No one wants to be on the receiving end of these Dragons' fiery breath attack, which surpasses that of their younger kin in both might and enlightenment.
Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.
Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.
The crystal protects those who worship the Serpent God, healing wounds and bringing supplicants back from the point of death.
Some Dragons breathe noxious fumes that have a long-lasting effect on their target's coordination - if it survived the attack in the first place.
The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.
The youngest Dragons have a warm hue to their scales and a fiery temper, with scorching breath to match.
As the Flamespyre swoops, wreathes of fire squall off its wings in the bird’s wake.
Blowing on a glimmering golden whistle, the Wizard summons the spirit of Gehenna’s metal hounds to hunt down his prey.
'Better out than in' is a questionable maxim—particularly for the unfortunates caught in this deadly, reeking draught.
By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.
The Wizard destroys the foe from within, corroding their minds with doubt and crisis.
Use wisely, because just one careless puff will turn the Chaos Dwarfs' own ranks to cinders!
""Wait and see," he said. "We'll have a roaring fire, just when we want it!" He was right…"
A steady beat symbolises the staunch defences of the Bastion, a bulwark through which no enemy shall break.
Urged on by the pounding of drums, the Cathayan warriors fight untouched by fear, unleashing the fury of the Dragon on their foes.
This one's bark is at least as bad as their bite…
As the rising tempo reaches a crescendo, every man gives way to the rage of war, carrying their fury into every charge.
The piercing howl of the Incarnate Elemental of Beasts freezes the blood and fills all who hear it with mortal fear.
Before the enemy has seen the Lion in a single glance, its jade breath has burnt them to cinders.
The force of such a clash of fangs echoes out across the battlefield, forcing whole waves of men to their knees.
Those who cannot find shelter from this raging tempest of arcane power are sure to wither and break beneath its every wave.
Woe to the man or beast bearing this cursed mark, for the Lore of Yin has found an unwilling target and doom trails their every step.
Don't get anywhere near this silvery-blue flame as it gushes forth. Best not even look at it, in fact. Certainly do not touch it if you value your continued existence.
Who would have thought such a small, unassuming object could cause such overwhelming damage?
Every woven strand of net bears a powerful hex, draining every ounce of pace from the prey caught in its binds.
Distilled from the blood of Hag Queens, this evil brew drives imbibers into an ecstasy of destruction.
A magical of shifting darkness and howling wind snatches the enemy’s missiles from the air, even as they are fired, and hurls them back at their owners.
A single glance is enough to have any heart engulfed in abject terror, leaving mere mortals frozen in fear, unable to escape.
"All power to the engines – time is of the essence!"
As the Gyrocopter squadron speeds over the heads of the enemy, each pilot releases a single wing-mounted bomb onto targets below.
A vicious spear of steel explodes from the Airship with force, brutally impaling anyone and anything in its path.
With a sudden rush of piping hot steam, the Thunderbarge soars forward at speed, taking the battlefield by storm.
Being crushed or eaten may be a blessing when the alternative is choking on blood and puss as it slowly fills the lungs!
Dual axe-edges carve through foes, lashing out in a spiral of slaughter, and leaving nought but a bloody mess in their wake.
A copious natural by-product of this noisome Colossal Squig's healthy digestion. Just don't step in it.
If it stays digested, anything this Colossal Squig eats is generally no longer considered a threat. Once it dies, all such considerations fall to the wayside.
"Get 'em flailin' an' confused. Makes fightin' more fun. Get 'em smoked. Makes 'em taste better."
Picky eaters are frowned upon amongst the Ogres. Picky fighters, however, are some of the deadliest amongst them.
When Orcs are determined to cleave something in half, very few things can stop them from doing so.
By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens, until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.
Spirits of the departed assail the Wizard’s foes, sapping their resolve and causing dread among their numbers.
With a mighty bellow, the spellcaster invokes Corvus the Crow Lord, summoning his servants to peck at the foe's eyes.
A salt-scented mist rolls in across the battlefield, corroding the enemy's resolve and shrouding the Asur with ethereal caress.
The innate hatred carried within a Preyton makes it despise itself almost as much as its foes, whose attacks are repaid with added enmity.
The terror is in knowing what its maw will do once it finally emerges.
Three snapping maws signal the Chimera’s unbridled destructive potential, with one harbouring the possibility of a fiery death.
An ever-shifting dermis of bright colours and hues turns translucent one moment, before running like molten wax to heal tainted flesh the next.
Is it a prayer to war, or a primal acclamation to the Wolf-God? It amounts to all and the same.
Under such eyes, one's martial resolve withers – for behind them is the Wolf, daring you to lay a hand upon him.
The supernatural solution is often the best; weapons materialise in hands, allowing them to slice through flesh, soul, and consciousness.
The caster unleashes a vile disease that scours the battlefield in search of victims to infect and instantly petrify.
Those who ferry the Queen's exquisite throne once longed for her too...
Lahmians have grown skilled in the art of prescience to stay one step ahead of the agents who hunt them.
Usirian's scarabs prepare the dead for their existence as pure souls by stripping them of all fleshly remnants: a terrible fate to befall the yet-living.
When the Acolytes stewarding the Hurricanum achieve a perfect alignment, fiery comets come streaking out of the skies.
Reality itself melts into an unholy paste of vermin-made blasphemy whenever the cannon fires its profane lightning.
A minute adjustment of the Hurricanum's orrery can reduce formerly clear skies to a glowering rage.
Some souls do not deserve an afterlife. The only piece of it they see is Usirian's Icon engraved upon its most sacred Titans. After that – eternal nothingness.
Like their huge, earth-boring equivalents, Warp-Grinders can turn solid rock into dust on a smaller scale, halting enemies’ movements by pulverising the ground beneath them.
The Sands are where the Khemric Titans dwell. Reducing enemy ranks to dust widens their domain.
When transfixed by its gaze, creatures feel their movements slow and their mind begin to unravel.
No formation can withstand the swing of these Giant-wielded hooked blades, either instantly disembowelling victims or leaving them reeling and gravely vulnerable to the next blow.
When the War Compass is so primed, even heavenly bodies are not outside its devastating reach.
The War Compass funnels deadly electricity from the heavens to sear and burn and smite the foe.
The exquisite kiss of the Dark Prince's three-tailed whip strikes the enemy with a delicious fury.
The spellcaster utters the vilest of phrases and belches forth an impossibly foul, poisonous cloud.
The most putrescent vapour fills the air, loosening lunches and bowels, and causing violent, crippling vomiting seizures in nearby foes.
A poisonous spurt of diseased gas and bile spews forth from the spellcaster's diseased lungs, drenching the enemy in vile, choking pus.
The spellcaster's corrupting touch puts their victims into a blissful, euphoric state for a short time, rendering them little able to move, let alone defend themselves.
A complex sigil is performed, transfixing the enemy with a shifting array of hallucinatory images that disjoint and befuddle, inviting their deaths.
With a twist of the hand, the spellcaster causes the bodies of their opponents to be consumed by coruscating blue flames.
A roiling tide of iridescent energy flows from the spellcaster, enveloping their enemies in a cone of searing magical flame.
When the land itself fights back, the enemy is petrified by its freezing touch, meaning the slightest gust will see them shatter into dust.
Control the skies above the battlefield and you can be assured of success upon on the ground below – gravity is your ally, remember.
Ignition of this gunpowder mixture causes shavings to quickly scatter into a foul, painful cloud, leaving enemies vulnerable to the cut-and-thrust of close quarters combat.
"Death is like a winter chill; No door can keep it from us; And summer yet may bloom again; Though ice be all upon us."
Reach into the realm of the Raven God and his blessings may just reach back.
All fear the wrath of the storm-god Tor, striking foes down in a barrage of divine lightning!
Angry spirits inhabit discs of great power, spewing Tzeentchian fire on all those below.
By means of the Lore of Shadows, the Wizard causes the enemy to be worn down by their own burdens until they are enervated to a sorry standstill.
At one with the frozen plains and snowy tundra of Kislev, wherever this one goes, they bring the icy heart of the Motherland with them.
A spray of sizzling silver slivers rain from the sky to impale the caster's enemy.
Just as a leech draws blood, the Wizard extends an ebon hand towards the chosen foe, sucking away their spirit through the tainted Lore of Death.
By which the Great Unclean One calls down a disgusting shower of putrid yuck to heal themselves and harm those foes unfortunate enough to be caught in it.
An icy carapace surrounds the Stonehorn, slowing the lumbering beast down further while adding a layer of natural armour to their defences.
The Wizard casts an arcane net, created to hold the Great Deceiver himself. Any caught in its strands will struggle to act.
Prickly gorse bursts from the ground around the caster's allies, protecting them from attack like a spiky, living shield.
At the spellcaster's command, nebulous nature spirits assail the foe, clawing with hands not nearly as insubstantial as they first appear.
What beauty and violence there is in the dance? A flurry of blades and a certain savagery of intent...
The wending and twisting of the Wardancers hardens their spirits and their bodies against would-be attackers.
The Wardancer threads and loops, contorting to create an ethereal fabric that turns aside arrows and bolts.
Those marked for death by the mighty Ranger or his crew may find their armour and shield of little practical use…
Somewhat surprisingly, even the deadliest Arachnarok feels protective of her brood, and can draw them to her at will.
The Gyrobomber is fitted with much larger ordnance than the Gyrocopter. Should the multiple payloads hit their intended target the results will be quite spectacular!
Clogging the senses with acrid, stinging smoke leaves an enemy completely vulnerable.
The Goblin Fanatics of Karak Eight Peaks eschew the use of balls with their chains, favouring shaved Dwarfs instead!
Forming a wedge before the charge enables mounted Knights to smash through enemy lines, causing great disarray among their ranks.
The Wizard infuses his allies with Light Magic, freeing them from the passage of time and speeding up their actions.
Lightning arcs across the battlefield, leaping from foe-to-foe with crackling fury until there are none left within the storm.
Bolts of cleansing energy fly from the Wizard’s hands, searing evil wherever they strike.
The Hellcannon breaks its chains and rushes forwards. Increased movement speed.
The Gyrobomber is fitted with much larger ordnance than the Gyrocopter. Should the multiple payloads hit their intended target the results will be quite spectacular!
Sent mad by drinking fungus brew, Night Goblin Fanatics are released from their mobs as a twirling cyclone of destruction armed with a large ball and chain!
If you see him coming run as fast as you can… not that it will do you any good whatsoever!
You really don't want to make them angry. No, *really*.
Shadows be thy cloak and darkness thy ally.
Never make direct eye-contact with a Beastman lest it mark you out for a hideous, flesh-ripping demise.
마법사가 선택한 적에게 흑단 주먹을 뻗어, 부패한 마도술을 통해 적의 영혼을 빨아들입니다.
죽음의 비입니다! 무시무시한 해골이 뼈가 부서질듯한 위력으로 비처럼 쏟아지고, 치명적인 파편을 사방으로 날려보냅니다.
하늘이 열리며 불타는 화살, 순수한 카오스의 검은 벼락이 적을 향해 날아갑니다.
실체화된 암흑의 촉수가 뒤틀리며 뻗어나가, 적의 생명력을 흡수하고 시전자의 활력을 채웁니다.
샤이쉬의 약화하는 힘을 사용해 마법사가 적들의 생존 의지를 꺾습니다.
시전자가 금지된 이름을 읊조리면, 적이 고통의 파동에 시달립니다.
이 얼음장 같은 숨결은 차가운 죽음을 선사하며, 이 숨결을 맞고도 운좋게 살아남은 이들의 움직임을 둔화 시킵니다.

이 구체를 소유한 자는 주변의 적을 가차 없이 끌어들이는 고통과 죽음의 소용돌이를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.
소텍의 꿈틀거리는 수하들이 착용자를 둘러싸, 앞으로 다가올 전투에 더 많은 전력을 제공하고 착용자를 보호합니다.
이글거리는 광선이 하늘에서 내리 꽂히면 적들은 도망치거나 비명을 지르며 타 죽고 맙니다. 어지간하면 후자 쪽이 낫죠!
이 바위들은 그냥 돌무더기가 아니며, 목표의 장갑을 박살내 방어력을 크게 떨어뜨립니다.
죽음을 부정하는 능력이란 실로 놀라운 것입니다, 그 반동이 좀 심각하긴 하지만 말입니다...
이 황금 장막은 리자드맨의 전설 속 황금 도시 만큼이나 오래된 물건으로, 착용자와 그 동맹에게 사격에 대한 저항을 제공해 줍니다.
러스트리아 반점 두꺼비는 그 존재 자체만으로도 저 무자비한 리퍼닥틸들을 통제 불능의 광란과 폭력성에 빠지도록 몰아넣습니다!
황제의 분노는 전투 도중에도 주기적으로 증기를 분출시켜주어야 하며, 그 분출 소리가 마치 귀청 찢어지는 귀곡성과도 같아서 가까이 다가온 적들에게 죽음을 선고하는 듯합니다.
지금은 보이지만, 이제는 안 보입니다... 그리고 이젠 둘로 보이는군요...

적들을 향해 복잡한 인장을 그려내 끊임없이 변화하는 환각을 보여 주면서 스스로의 죽음을 초래하도록 유도합니다.
시전자가 손 한번 까딱이면 적들은 걷잡을 수 없는 푸른 불꽃에 완전히 집어 삼켜지고 맙니다.
시전자로부터 오색빛깔 요동치는 기운이 물결치듯 흘러나와 뜨거운 마법 화염으로 적들을 감싸 버립니다.
대지의 반격에 휘말린 적들은 뼈를 에는 혹한에 꽁꽁 얼어붙은 채 한 줄기 산들바람만 닿더라도 산산히 부서지는 꼴이 되고 맙니다.
전장의 제공권을 장악한 순간 땅에서의 싸움은 승리한 것이나 다름없습니다. 중력을 자신의 편으로 만들었으니 말이죠.
이 화약 혼합물에 불이 붙으면 매캐하고 지독한 연기가 빠르게 확산하여 근접전에서 적에게 치명적인 피해를 입힐 수 있습니다.
"죽음은 겨울의 한기와 같아, 그 어떤 문으로도 막을 수 없다. 여름이 찾아오려면 멀었으니, 얼음만이 우리를 덮쳐온다."
갈까마귀 신의 영역에 가 닿으면 그 축복도 다시 돌아올지 모릅니다.
천둥신 토르의 분노를 보십시오, 그 적들에게 신성한 벼락 다발이 떨어지는 모습을 보고 두려워 하십시오!
분노한 영혼이 강력한 원반체에 깃든 채 날아다니며 젠취의 화염을 아래쪽으로 뿜어냅니다.
마법사가 그림자 마법학파의 마법을 사용해서 적들이 제 몸도 가누지 못할 정도로 쇠약해지다가 결국 스스로 무너지도록 만듭니다.
키슬레프의 얼어붙은 평원과 눈 덮인 툰드라가 함께 하는 자는 어디를 가든 어머니 조국의 차디찬 심장을 선사할 수 있습니다.
하늘에서 지글지글 끓는 은 조각이 쏟아져 적을 관통합니다.
마법사는 선택한 적에게 검은 주먹을 뻗고 죽음 학파의 마법을 부려, 마치 거머리가 피를 빨듯 적의 영혼을 빨아들입니다.
불결의 정점이 역겹고 부패한 체액을 쏟아내 자신을 치유하고, 그 범위에 함께 갇힌 불행한 희생자들에게는 피해를 입힙니다.
바위뿔을 얼음 껍질로 감싸 이 짐승의 이동 속도를 조금 늦추는 대신, 방어력을 높여 주는 원소 방패를 한 겹 씌웁니다.
마법사가 위대한 기만자를 잡기 위해 만든 비전의 그물을 던집니다. 이 올가미에 잡힌 목표물은 행동이 어려워집니다.
시전자와 아군 주변의 땅에서 가시 달린 살아있는 방패처럼 생긴 가시덩굴이 튀어나와 이들을 공격으로부터 보호합니다.
주문 시전자의 명에 흐릿한 혼령이 적을 엄습하고, 보기와는 달리 분명히 실체가 있는 손으로 할퀴어댑니다.
이 춤에는 어떤 아름다움과 폭력이 있을까요? 난무하는 칼날과 어떤 확고한 야만성입니다…
전쟁의 무희의 몸을 뒤트는 춤사위가 적의 공격에 맞서는 이들의 혼과 육신을 강화합니다.
전쟁의 무희가 보이지 않는 실을 꿰고, 엮고, 일그러뜨려서 화살 주위를 감는 영체 직물을 만듭니다.
막강한 순찰자에게 죽음의 표식이 찍힌 자는 갑옷과 방패가 별 쓸모 없게 됩니다…
다소 놀랍게도, 제아무리 위험한 아라크나록이라도 자기 새끼는 보호하려 하며, 의지에 따라 새끼를 불러 모을 수 있습니다.
자이로봄버는 자이로콥터보다 훨씬 큰 포를 장착하고 있습니다.
매섭게 감각을 방해하는 악취 나는 연기가 적을 완전히 취약하게 합니다.
카라크 여덟 봉우리의 고블린 광신도들은 사슬에 철구를 다는 것을 꺼리고, 대신 수염을 민 드워프를 달아 놓는 것을 선호합니다!
돌격 전에 쐐기 대형을 갖추면 마상 기사들이 적의 전선을 돌파해 적에게 크나큰 혼란을 불러일으킵니다.
마법사가 아군에게 빛의 마법을 불어넣어 시간의 흐름으로부터 자유롭게 하고 행동 속도를 올립니다.
벼락이 전장을 가로질러 폭풍 속에 남은 적이 없을 때까지 난폭하게 적을 타고 넘어가며 구워버립니다.
정화의 에너지 화살이 마법사의 손에서 발사되어 타격한 곳의 악을 불태웁니다.
지옥포가 사슬을 끊고 전진합니다. 이동 속도가 증가합니다.
자이로봄버는 자이로콥터보다 훨씬 큰 포를 장착하고 있습니다.
버섯주를 마셔서 정신이 나간 밤 고블린 광신도들이 무리에서 튀어나와 거대한 철구와 사슬로 파멸의 소용돌이를 만듭니다!
놈이 오는 것이 보이면 최대한 빨리 도망치십시오… 그래봤자 소용은 없겠지만요!
이들을 화나게 하는 일은 피해야 합니다. "절대로" 말이죠.
그림자가 그대의 망토가 되고 어둠이 그대의 편이 되리라.
비스트맨과 눈을 마주치지 마십시오. 처참하게 육신이 찢기는 죽음의 표적으로 찍힐 테니까요.

fields.name: active_time
fields.description: If this is a projectile then add -1 for active time

fields.name: always_affect_self
fields.description: The launch unit will always be affected by the ability

fields.name: only_affect_target
fields.description: The ability will only affect the target unit and will not search near units

fields.name: min_range
fields.description: The (targetted) ability can't be used within this range

fields.name: targetting_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when targetting

fields.name: passive_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability has been ordered but not yet cast (like if unit has to move their to cast)

fields.name: active_aoe
fields.description: This is the area of effect to display when ability is currently active (has been cast)

fields.name: activation_effect
fields.description: This is an optional one-shot vfx to display when cast to acknowledge order given

fields.name: miscast_chance
fields.description: The unary chance of a miscast occuring

fields.name: miscast_explosion
fields.description: The boom-boom when miscasting happens

fields.name: special_ability_display
fields.description: When wind_up_stance has an animation added, and windup_time is set to greater than zero, this references a table where you can override effects in the animations metadata.   The effect metadata needs to be set to be set to ability_weapon and ability_aura.

fields.name: voiceover_state
fields.description: the state for the voiceover that's played when this ability is activated (if any)

fields.name: additional_melee_cp
fields.description: Melee Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: additional_missile_cp
fields.description: Missile Combat Potential that is added to any unit that has this ability/item (from table: main_units). Must be >= 0.0 or the game will crash on startup.

fields.name: parent_ability
fields.description: Hack for spell browser in warhammer because designers want to put in specialised versions of abilities for certain characters. An ability with a parent wont show in browser, instead only parent is shown.

fields.name: spawn_proxy_vfx
fields.description: Vfx to show over each proxy decal when targetting spawn spell

fields.description: Setting this to false stops miscast chance modifiers from affecting the ability

fields.description: Entities will play a loop locomotion stance

fields.name: audio_switch_override
fields.description: If set, ability will use this switch for the modular UI

fields.name: current_mana_moves_to_reserve

fields.name: affect_siege_equipment

fields.name: shared_recharge_time

fields.name: intensity_based_activation

fields.name: autoresolver_usage
